notes.title: The patch is out - the game is stable now!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hello everyone! 

A few unpleasant bugs were found after we released the game, such as a mini-game crushing the application and a chinese translation bug. 

They're fixed now, so you can launch the game and enjoy it without any issues now. We're sorry for any inconvenience caused - thanks everyone for reporting and sharing your experience! 

Let us know in case you face any further problems or questions - we'll make sure to address them as soon as possible. 

Always there for you, BanzaiProject[/h3]

notes.title: Your own massage business will be open soon! 💆‍♀️
notes.notes:
[h3]After exploring a few other themes and plot genres, we've decided to bring back Sex Massage and look at it from a new perspective - this Saturday we're finally releasing the SEX Massage 2 🔞! 

Get ready to take the situation in your hands and save the massage parlour being on the verge of shutting down - get through everyday business owning struggles, gain new friends, find new customers and make this place a striving salon again. 

The game provides an engaging plot, hot&fun mini-games, a bunch of adult scenes with a variety to them and intriguing characters to explore. We've prepared a little something for the early birds - 
make sure to wishlist so you won't miss the release!
 
A handful of 18+ adult content, a fascinating story, and a lot of girls to discover - don't miss your chance of building a successful massage parlour![/h3]
